rules.description: Fail when code writes an API key, token, private key, or other secret into the synced project directory (the local project path, RemoteDir, or anything under it). Secrets belong in the laptop home config or the Sprite home directory such as ~/.config/opencode/env. Workspace state may record identity (sprite name, paths, session names) but never credentials. Reading a key in order to provision it onto the Sprite home directory is fine.
exceptions: The write target is under the user's home config or the Sprite home directory, not the project tree.
The value written is workspace identity such as a sprite name, path, or sync session name, not a credential.

rules.description: Fail when a function prints, logs, or interpolates an API key, token, private key, or other secret into stdout, stderr, or a log line. Diagnostics may include paths, sprite names, status, and error messages that do not contain the secret value.
exceptions: The value written is a path, sprite name, status, count, or a fixed message that does not include the secret.
The secret is written to a 0600 file, not to a log or the console.

rules.description: Fail when portable down, or a helper used only by down, destroys a Sprite, terminates a Mutagen session, deletes remote workspace data, or removes SSH config or project state. Down must only pause sync so the Sprite can sleep. Permanent deletion belongs to portable destroy.
exceptions: The call only pauses a Mutagen session or prints status.

rules.description: Fail when a Sprite is destroyed, a Mutagen session is terminated, SSH config is removed, or project state is unregistered outside portable destroy and the setup-failure path that runs only when keep_on_error is false. Creating, pausing, resuming, and listing workspaces pass.
exceptions: The function is failSetup, which destroys only after a setup failure when keep_on_error is false.
The call only creates, pauses, resumes, flushes, or lists a workspace or sync session.

rules.description: Fail when code writes ~/.ssh/config, authorized_keys, or another SSH identity or config file with permissions looser than 0600, or rewrites the user's SSH config without the marked portable Host block. Creating ~/.ssh at 0700 and writing the marked block at 0600 pass.
exceptions: The write uses 0600 for the file and 0700 for the ~/.ssh directory.
The rewrite preserves or updates only the marked portable Host block.

rules.description: Fail when a value from the user, config, or project is interpolated into a remote shell script or ssh/sprite command without shell quoting. Unquoted interpolation lets a path or tool command break out of the intended argument. Using shq, shellQuote, or an equivalent single-quote helper passes. Fixed string literals with no interpolation pass.
exceptions: The interpolated value is passed through shq, shellQuote, or an equivalent shell-quoting helper.
The string is a fixed literal with no user, config, or project value interpolated.

rules.description: Fail errors that are caught, ignored, or discarded without handling, logging, wrapping, or returning. Intentional best-effort operations pass when the intent is clear, such as cleanup after destroy or a missing optional file.
exceptions: The ignored error is from a best-effort cleanup, optional lookup, or missing file.
The error is logged or returned on the same path.
